sentences.text:
HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD ?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:AHC:106110 Court No. - 75 Case :- APPLICATION U/S 528 BNSS No. - 21288 of 2025 Applicant :- Durgesh And Another Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Anshu Singh,Hemendra Pratap Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
1. Heard Sri Akshay Pratap Singh, holding brief of Sri Hemendra Pratap Singh learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Pankaj Kumar Rai learned State Law Officer for the State.
2.

This application under Section 528 BNSS has been filed by the applicants to quash the entire proceedings of Complaint Case No. 12596 of 2023, Priti Vs. Durgesh and others, under Sections 498-A, 323 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Baghwala, District Etah as well as Summoning order dated 25.06.2024 passed by learned A.C.J.M./Fastrack Court, Etah.

3. Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that the applicants happens to be the husband and the father-in-law of the opposite party no.2 and the marriage of the applicant no.1 stood solemnized with the opposite party no.2 on 17.7.2013 with respect to the allegations purported to be under Sections 313, 323, 498A, 504 IPC read with Section 3/4 of the D.P. Act, first information report was lodged by the opposite party no.2 against the applicants and five others before Police Durgesh And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179441092/
1 Station Mhua Kheda, Aligarh being FIR No.0087 of 2023.

entities.text: Police Durgesh And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
He has further submitted that thereafter the impugned complaint has been lodged on 20.6.2023 purported to be under Sections 147, 148,
149, 494, 504, 506, 323, 109 452 IPC with an allegation that though the marriage of the applicant no.1 stood solemnized with the opposite party no.2 on 17.7.2023 and in the marriage itself expenditures and gifts worth 26 lakhs were incurred, however, as from the wedlock of the opposite party no.2 and applicant has female child was born but sarcastic comments were being made with respect to the fact that no male child was born and all sorts of obstructions made in the peaceful living and assault was also made and on 26.5.2023 the opposite party no.2 was thrown out of her matrimonial house and send to her maternal house and on 29.5.2023 an information was received that the applicant no.1 was going to solemnized marriage with somebody else and when the same came to be the knowledge when it was resisted then assault so made by the applicants faction.
4. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that on the basis of the statements under Section 200 Cr.P.C. of the victim opposite party no.2 followed by Munish Chandra under Section 202 Cr.P.C.,
Satyavir under Section 202 Cr.P.C. the applicants came to be summoned on 25.6.2024 under Sections 498A, 323 IPC and 3/4 of the D.P. Act.
5. Questioning the summoning order the applicants filed the present application..
6. Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that the allegations so sought to be levelled in the complaint are not only false incorrect but they have no nexus with reality.
He has further submitted that just in order to harass the applicants to all levels the complaint has been lodged.

He has further submitted that even the applicants were subjected to harassment by means of lodging of an FIR bearing no.0087 on 30.3.2023 under Sections 313, 323, 504 498A IPC read with Section 3/4 of the D.P. Act and within three months the present complaint has been lodged, there is no iota of evidence to show that the applicants had assaulted or there is no injury report.
7. Learned counsel for the applicants also seeks to rely upon the judgement of Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of T.T. Antony vs. State of Kerala and others AIR 2001 SC 2637.

entities.text: T.T. Antony vs. State of Kerala and others AIR 2001 SC 2637
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
He submits that as per the instructions the applicants shall be preferring a discharge application and till the disposal of the discharge application no coercive action be taken.
8.

Learned State Law Officer on the other hand submits that whatever might be what is required at this stage of summoning is the fact as to whether there is any material contradiction so as to hold that the proceedings cannot be undergone.
He further submits that in case the applicants seeks to file a discharge application he has no objection.

9. Considering the submissions so made across the bar and looking into the nature of the allegations as well as the oral aspect of the matter and the stand taken by the applicants, the present application stands disposed of directing the applicants to submit a discharge application by 31.7.2025 and on the same motion the court below shall decide the discharge application with most expedition.

10. Till the disposal of the discharge application no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in Complaint Case No. 12596 of 2023, Priti Vs. Durgesh and others, under Sections Durgesh And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179441092/
